verdict.rationale: Colorado's business entity, DBA, tax and UCC filing data is published on the state open-data portal (data.colorado.gov), and the SOS business page links to an 'Intelligence Center - Business data' and data requests. A hands-on probe confirmed a keyless GET to the business-entities dataset returns JSON, so the registry data is available as a machine-readable extract with no scraping needed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-file bulk export formats (e.g., CSV/whole-dataset download) and update cadence or schema for the business registry dataset; the data is served from the Socrata portal rather than the SOS registry itself.
